assumptions.arrival: Completed bars assumed available at minute close; original arrival receipts are not supplied to this scenario
assumptions.source: Eight-column bars do not independently prove feed, universe or revision selection; retain the export receipt
assumptions.quotes: Synthetic quotes around completed closes; historical executable quotes are not supplied to this scenario
assumptions.borrow: Every candidate assumed borrow-eligible; historical eligibility is not supplied to this scenario
assumptions.entry: First full minute open after decision, within original limit and modeled one-minute working window
assumptions.exit: OHLC stop/target proxies with stop-first both-touch convention and resting gapped stop limits; first full minute open after time deadline; missing exit prices remain unresolved
assumptions.liquidity: Whole intended quantity assumed filled at the price proxy; capacity and queue priority are unmeasured
assumptions.basket: Legs fill independently; planned dollar neutrality does not prove realized neutrality
assumptions.costs: Sell fee and fixed slippage scenarios; operating expense, borrow, impact and real settlement are unmeasured
assumptions.selection: Current candidate universe applied retrospectively; chronological slices are descriptive, not holdout validation
assumptions.runtime: Exercises signal, funding and planner functions; omits ingestion, authority, final risk and broker recovery
